summary: Executed backend regression and mobile-first UI/integration tests on public preview URL. Verified onboarding->signup auth, Smart Detection parse/accept flow, Analytics and Profile reference sections, and mobile overflow/CTA reachability at 390x844.

integration_issues.issue: xAI Grok API key is rejected (HTTP 400 invalid key) in backend logs; detection still works through fallback parser and renders inline preview.
Intermittent Metro/tunnel instability observed (console 'Disconnected from Metro (1006)' and ngrok restart errors in supervisor logs), though UI flow recovered and tests completed.

action_items: Replace/repair GROK_API_KEY to re-enable primary AI parsing path (fallback currently masks key issue).
Investigate Expo tunnel/Metro disconnect flakiness in supervisor/ngrok path to reduce intermittent preview instability.
Wire Profile edit control to an actual action and add testID to keep it testable and non-deceptive.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/components/ProfileScreen.tsx: 'Edit' is rendered as Pressable without onPress/testID, creating a dead interactive control.
frontend/components/AnalyticsScreen.tsx: progress fill enforces minimum 8% for zero-count stages, which can visually misrepresent pipeline distribution.
frontend/components/DetectionScreen.tsx: accept()/ignore() API calls have no local try/catch; API failures can surface as unhandled interaction errors without user feedback.
seed_data_creation: Created unique TEST users via signup and created detection/application records during UI/API validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL is functional. Required Smart Detection, Analytics, and Profile reference sections are present and pass at 390x844 with no horizontal overflow; scroll is needed to validate lower footer/reminder rows.
rca_of_issue: Primary unresolved integration issue is external-key failure: backend logs show xAI returning HTTP 400 invalid API key, causing deterministic fallback parser usage. Reproduction: sign in -> Detection tab -> Analyze application. Mitigation: rotate/fix GROK_API_KEY and retest parse config_message + ai_available behavior.
